audit_kind: Published-input classical infinite obstruction for arbitrary predetermined sparse original-block layouts, with kernel-checked local arithmetic and whole-positive-moment degree bridges; separately a manuscript-dependent near-quadratic consequence of the OpenAI prime-predecessor law.
goal_turn_classification_scope: The substantive result is the classical arbitrary-layout arithmetic obstruction, with exact selector weighting. The stronger exponent is a deduction from a separately identified unverified-here preprint theorem. No new acquisition upper bound is claimed.
user_frontier: Whole-family Otilde(m) acquisition or a rigorous scoped obstruction; examples and backend certificates alone do not count.
source_snapshot_scope: Fresh selected current-source snapshot after migration; not a silent refresh or full native recheck of the historical parent audit.

published_input.source: Kurlberg and Pomerance, Acta Arithmetica 119.2 (2005), Section 4, Lemma 19; explicit Baker--Harman (7.1) formulation

arbitrary_layout_obstruction.layout_scope: K_m depends only on m; any placement in the original block domain; O(m^eta) positions; fixed polylogarithmic menu permitted
arbitrary_layout_obstruction.local_collision_partition: k=k_prime and delta_j=delta_j_prime as exact integers
arbitrary_layout_obstruction.whole_family_denominator_floor: (m-1)*|K_m| <= 2*deg U for exact U B=V, U(0)=1

openai_collection_review.review_scope: All family titles/summaries screened; selected source scans, theorem statements, computational models and proof mechanisms inspected; no independent proof audit of all 722 manuscripts.

manuscript_dependent_stronger_obstructio.input_theorem: The Poisson--Dirichlet law for prime predecessors, Theorem 1.1
manuscript_dependent_stronger_obstructio.status: Rigorous classical deduction from the manuscript theorem; stronger unconditional verification is not credited here.
manuscript_dependent_stronger_obstructio.large_factor_density_contract: For every fixed kappa<1, positive prime proportion with prime R(p)|p-1 and R(p)>p^kappa.
manuscript_dependent_stronger_obstructio.consecutive_whole_family_degree_floor: deg U >= m^(2-epsilon)/8 on infinitely many actual long-base-2 inputs.
manuscript_dependent_stronger_obstructio.arbitrary_layout_degree_floor: Omega(m^(3/2-epsilon)) when layout size is comparable to m^(1/2-epsilon).

kernel_checked_arithmetic_bridge.gap_quantifiers: All selected signed position differences and all integer period multiples; no interval filling.

limitations: The classical infinitude and actual-route proof are not yet kernel checked.
The stronger near-quadratic exponent uses an unformalized preprint theorem not fully audited here.
Layout positions depend only on m except selection from a fixed polylogarithmic menu.
No no-go for arbitrary input-dependent/adaptive layouts, implicit/sparse circuits, signed observables or nonunit-pivot recovery.
Degree and retained dense coefficient slots are representation floors, not lower bounds for all factoring algorithms.
next_required_advance: An N-only per-input source-preserving representation/channel with paid Otilde(m) whole-family acquisition, or a stronger arithmetic obstruction for its precisely specified contract; full bit-time and peak-working-memory proof remains necessary.
